title: Luna dynamical-spectrum row
description: One row in Luna's per-body action-angle decomposition. Two row_types coexist with shared required fields and row-type-specific optional fields, mirroring the saturn_rings + mercury_dynamical_spectrum descriptor pattern. dynamical_mode rows (the 11 angle/action modes from LUNA_DYNAMICAL_MODES) carry mode kinematics. saros_commensurability rows (the 4 entries in SAROS_COMMENSURABILITY) carry the integer-commensurability closure invariant — 223 synodic ≈ 239 anomalistic ≈ 242 draconitic months ≈ 19 eclipse-years ≈ 6585.32 days.

name.description: Row identifier. For dynamical_mode rows: the mode name (e.g., 'synodic_mean_motion', 'forced_libration_longitude', 'eccentricity'). For saros_commensurability rows: the integer-product label (e.g., '223_synodic_months').

row_type.description: Row category. dynamical_mode = an angle or action variable in Luna's action-angle decomposition (four classical lunar months + spin lock + libration + precession angles + eccentricity / inclination / obliquity actions). saros_commensurability = one of the four near-equal products (223 synodic, 239 anomalistic, 242 draconitic months, 19 eclipse-years) that close the ~6585.32-day Saros invariant.

frequency_per_century.description: Mode frequency in cycles per century (negative for retrograde modes like nodal precession). For dynamical_mode rows only; null for saros_commensurability. 0.0 indicates a pure-action row (eccentricity / inclination / obliquity).

period_days.description: Equivalent period in days for cycle-class modes; 0.0 for pure-action rows. For dynamical_mode rows only; null for saros_commensurability.

amplitude_value.description: Characteristic amplitude of the mode in source-units (see amplitude_units). For dynamical_mode rows only; null for saros_commensurability.

amplitude_units.description: Units of amplitude_value. For dynamical_mode rows only; null for saros_commensurability.

angle_or_action.description: Whether the mode is an angle variable (lives on a torus, periodic mod 2π) or an action variable (slowly varying real interval). For dynamical_mode rows only; null for saros_commensurability.

integer_count.description: Integer multiplier in the Saros commensurability (223 / 239 / 242 / 19). For saros_commensurability rows only; null for dynamical_mode.

unit_period_days.description: Period of the underlying lunar-month or eclipse-year unit being multiplied. For saros_commensurability rows only; null for dynamical_mode.

product_days.description: integer_count * unit_period_days. The four product values must agree within ~0.5 day; that's the Saros closure invariant the catalogue ratchets. For saros_commensurability rows only; null for dynamical_mode.

precision_flag.description: Per-§17.1.6 ship-readiness convention. 'high' = published precision is rigorous and modern; 'medium' for the eclipse-year approximation in the Saros closure (the units are millennium-stable mean periods, not perturbed).

notes.description: Per-row free-text notes — historical context, measurement caveats, cross-references.

source_doi.description: DOI of the peer-reviewed paper or canonical reference authorising this row's numerical values. ISBN form acceptable for textbook citations (Allen's, Murray-Dermott, Meeus); 'historical:' prefix acceptable for pre-DOI works (Cassini 1693).

source_published_date.description: ISO 8601 partial date — 'YYYY' for textbooks / historical works, 'YYYY-MM' for journal issues, 'YYYY-MM-DD' for online papers / specific historic dates. Curator-authored from the cited DOI's metadata.

entered_locally_at.description: ISO 8601 date when this row was first added to the AMSC catalogue or last meaningfully amended. Aligns with Dublin Core dcterms:dateAccessioned.

source_version.description: Optional. For ephemeris kernels (e.g., 'DE441'), textbook editions ('4th edition', '1st edition'), or archive release tags. Null for journal papers where the DOI fully resolves the version.
